{{a|Tough Claws}}{{tt|*|As Mega Charizard X}} |nature=Lonely |type1=Fire |type2=Flying |media=special |prevonum=004 |evolution=2 |numeps1=25 |numeps2=12 |evo1num=005 |evo2num=006 |epnum=PS552 |epname=They Have a Flare for a Li'l Kanga-Napping |catchepnum=PS559 |catchepname=Chespin Sows the Seeds of Change |firststagename=Charmander |secondstagename=Charmeleon |firstevoep=PS577 |firstevoname=Quilladin Stands |secondevoep=PS589 |secondevoname=Charizard Transforms |current=[[Party|With X]] |va=no }} '''Salamè''' (Japanese: '''サラメ''' ''Salamè'') is a {{p|Charizard}} that {{adv|X}} owns in [[Pokémon Adventures]] and his third {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} overall. X received him from [[Professor Sycamore]]. He is at [[level]] 42 and his [[Characteristic]] is that he "nods off a lot." ==History== [[File:Sycamore and Salame.png|thumb|left|200px|Charmander and Professor Sycamore]] Salamè was originally a [[first partner Pokémon]] owned by [[Professor Sycamore]]. Salamè debuted as a Charmander in ''[[PS552|They Have a Flare for a Li'l Kanga-Napping]]'', standing besides Professor Sycamore and his {{p|Bulbasaur}} and {{p|Squirtle}}. Prior to ''[[PS558|What Does Charmander Do When It Dozes]]'', Charmander ran away from Sycamore's lab and took a nap in the flowerbeds on {{rt|4|Kalos}}. As he slept, his tail accidentally came in contact with the flowers, setting them ablaze. As Charmander freaked out, the [[Croaky|Froakie]] that was traveling with {{adv|X}}'s group put the fire out with his Frubbles. When [[Marisso|Chespin]] and {{p|Froakie}} recognized Charmander, X's group realized he must belong to Professor Sycamore. They decided to take Charmander and return him to the professor, but he was taken by [[Sina]] and [[Dexio]] after they mistook X's group for thieves. Using his [[Roller Skates]], {{adv|Tierno}} took back Charmander and explained the situation to Sina and Dexio. [[File:X and Salame.png|thumb|left|200px|Salamè and X]] After returning Charmander Professor Sycamore questioned why X didn't let {{p|Chespin}} on his team. When X explained why, Professor Sycamore decided to have a battle and made X use Chespin while he used Charmander. X agreed but refused to actively take a part in the battle, forcing Chespin to fight by himself. With no {{pkmn|Trainer}} and at a type-disadvantage, Chespin was dealt heavy blows but refused to give up. Chespin's determination managed to impress X enough to actually take a part in the battle and had him attack with {{m|Rollout}}. Despite the powerful attack, Chespin was defeated. After the battle, X decided to keep Chespin and named him Marisso, and also took Charmander, which he nicknamed Salamè. In ''[[PS562|Pangoro Poses a Problem]]'', Salamè teamed up with [[Kanga and Li'l Kanga|Kanga]] and Marisso to battle the [[Lumiose Press editor-in-chief]] to protect [[Alexa]]. While Kanga and Marisso battled {{p|Pangoro}}, Salamè began to fight one of the chief's {{p|Spewpa}}. Due to it using {{m|Rage Powder}}, he was unable to listen to X's commands when he told him to attack the Pangoro. He eventually defeated the Spewpa but was left exhausted, allowing Pangoro to grab him and Marisso with its paws. X then told Salamè to release his tail, which caused Pangoro's leaf to burn up. Without the leaf allowing it to sense what Kanga and Li'l Kanga were doing, the two quickly defeated it. In ''[[PS577|Quilladin Stands]]'', Salamè trained alongside Marisso under the tutelage of [[Gurkinn]]. Eventually, Salamè and Marisso [[Evolution|evolved]] into a Charmeleon and {{p|Quilladin}}, respectively. Salamè was [[PS578|later]] used in X's attempt to break into [[Team Flare Secret HQ|Team Flare's hideout]] in [[Geosenge Town]]. While sneaking in, Salamè used {{m|Incinerate}} to defeat a {{tc|Team Flare Grunt}}'s {{p|Noibat}}. Once inside Salamè teamed up with Marisso to fight [[Lysandre]]'s {{TP|Lysandre|Pyroar}} and {{p|Mienfoo}}. After a quick fight, X recalled them both so he could battle with one of his Pokémon that could [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolve]]. [[File:Salame hiding in Pokeball.png|thumb|left|150px|Salamè hiding in his Poké Ball]] [[File:Blue X Charizard defeating Xerosic.png|thumb|200px|Salamè and Blue's Charizard defeating Xerosic]] In ''[[PS587|Malamar Traps]],'' after X and his friends left to confront [[Team Flare]] at the [[Pokémon Village]], X revealed that Salamè began refusing to leave his {{i|Poké Ball}} after seeing the rest of X's team have their Mega Stones react to the [[Anistar City]] sundial. X later realized that Salamè became depressed due to fear that he may not be able to handle the power of Mega Evolution when he evolved into a {{p|Charizard}}. After seeing Marisso risk himself to protect him from [[Xerosic]]'s {{p|Malamar}}, Salamè regained his confidence and joined the battle. Although Xerosic was confident that Charizard did not have a Mega Evolution, Salamè revealed that he had been keeping a [[Charizardite X]] on his tail the entire time. Despite this, Xerosic refused to give up and continues battling by sending out more Pokémon to fight. {{adv|Blue}} joined in the fight to assist X, revealing that he is also a Mega Evolution Successor possessing a Key Stone in the process. After Salamè evolved into his final form, both X and Blue activated their Key Stones to Mega Evolve both of their Pokémon into Mega Charizard X for X and Mega {{TP|Blue|Charizard}} Y for Blue. The combined might of both Mega-Evolved Pokémon proved to be more than enough to defeat Xerosic. Salamè [[PS590|later]] tried to help suppress {{adv|Mewtwo}}'s rage at the [[Pokémon Village]] alongside Charizard, {{TP|Blue|Rhyperior}}, and Marisso. Despite their numbers, Mewtwo kept the advantage, easily knocking them away with {{m|Psywave}}. In ''[[PS593|Xerneas Gives]]'', X had his final battle against Lysandre and his {{adv|Zygarde}}. X used the power of five Key Stones to simultaneously Mega Evolve his five capable Pokémon at once. With their combined strength, Salamè, Kanga, Li'l Kanga, [[Élec]], {{p|Gengar|Garma}}, and {{p|Pinsir|Rute}} fought against Zygarde in order to defeat it. The combined might of X's team successfully forced Zygarde to split apart into its Cells, which led to Lysandre's defeat. ==Personality and characteristics== [[File:Charizardite X Adventures.png|thumb|left|150px|Salamè's Charizardite X]] [[File:Salame accidental fire.png|thumb|250px|Salamè causing a fire]] Salamè is an absentminded and ditsy Pokémon. He is very easygoing and tends to move at his own pace, which sometimes results in him causing trouble for others. He has a habit of holding his tail, which he retained even after evolving into {{p|Charmeleon}} and {{p|Charizard}}, and he does so to protect his [[Charizardite X]]. Prior to his [[Evolution]] into Charizard, he had a lot of self doubt about evolving and later [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolving]], but he was able to overcome it with the help of his childhood friend [[Marisso]]. {{-}} ==Appearance== :''See also: [[Mega Evolution]]'' {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{fire color}}; {{roundy}}; border: 3px solid #{{dragon color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{fire color light}}; {{roundytl|5px}}" | As a {{pcolor|Charmander|000}} ! style="background:#{{fire color light}};" | As a {{pcolor|Charmeleon|000}} ! style="background:#{{dragon color light}}; {{roundytr|5px}}" | As a Mega Charizard X |- style="background:#fff" | [[File:X Salamè Charmander.png|x220px]] | [[File:X Salame Charmeleon.png|x220px]] | [[File:X Salame Mega Charizard X.png|140px]] |} ==Moves used== {{anmov/h|fire|flying| {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Salamè Charmander Ember|1=Salamè Incinerate|2=Salame Mega Charizard X Flare Blitz}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Ember as a Charmander|1=Incinerate as a Charmeleon|2=Flare Blitz as Mega Charizard X}}}} {{anmov|fire|Ember|PS559|Chespin Sows the Seeds of Change}} {{anmov|fire|Incinerate|PS578|Gyarados Changes}} {{anmov|fire|Flare Blitz|PS593|Xerneas Gives}} {{anmov/f|flying}} ==Trivia== * Salamè is X's only [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolving]] Pokémon that evolved under his ownership. ==Names== {| class="roundy" style="float:left; background: #{{fire color light}}; border: 3px solid #{{flying color}}" |- !
